title: Members
description: Everyone who belongs to this cooperative, and what each of them has contributed.
tableCaption: Members of this cooperative, with their member code, status, location and joining date.
loadFailed: We could not load the member register. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: That member is not here
notFound.body: The record may have been opened from an old link, or it belongs to another cooperative.

stats.withoutPhoneHint: This many members cannot be reached by SMS and have to be told another way.
stats.wholeRegister: These figures cover the whole register, not the filtered list below.

search.label: Search members
search.placeholder: Name, member code or phone number

empty.title: No members yet
empty.body: Add your first cooperative member to start building the register. A name is all you need.

emptyFiltered.title: Nobody matches these filters
emptyFiltered.body: Try a different status or position, or clear the filters to see the whole register.

export.failed: We could not produce the file. Check your connection and try again.

form.createDescription: A first and family name is all that is required. Everything else can be filled in later from the office.
form.editDescription: Change what you know. Leaving a field empty clears what was stored there.
form.created: {{name}} was added to the register as {{code}}.

fields.nationalIdHint: Sixteen digits, as printed on the card.
fields.phoneHint: Many members have no phone. Leave this empty when there is none.
fields.notesHint: Anything the office should remember about this member.

fieldErrors.nationalId: A national identity number is sixteen digits.
fieldErrors.phone: That is not a Rwandan mobile number. Leave the field empty if there is none.
fieldErrors.email: That is not a valid email address.
fieldErrors.dateOfBirth: Write the date of birth as a real date.
fieldErrors.joinedOn: Write the joining date as a real date.

statusDialog.title: Change the status of {{name}}
statusDialog.description: A member is never deleted. Their record and their contribution history always stay in the books.
statusDialog.reasonHint: Kept with the record, so the change can be explained later.
statusDialog.exitedOnHint: The register keeps the period they were a member.
statusDialog.exitedOnRequired: Say which day they left the cooperative.

confirmStatus.title: Set {{name}} to {{status}}?
confirmStatus.body: They stop counting as an active member from now on. Everything already recorded stays exactly as it is, and you can set them back to active at any time.

profile.detailsDescription: What the office holds about this member.

summary.withheld: Your role does not cover this figure

timeline.title: History
timeline.description: Everything recorded for this member, newest first.
timeline.emptyBody: Record a contribution or a share, and it will appear here with its date.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Money this member has paid to the cooperative.
contributions.caption: Contributions from this member, with the date, type, amount and method of payment.
contributions.emptyBody: When this member pays a fee, savings or a levy, record it here so the books match the cash.
contributions.withheld: Your role does not cover contributions, so this list is not shown.
contributions.loadFailed: We could not load this member’s contributions.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Shares this member holds in the cooperative.
shares.caption: Share movements for this member, with the date, type, quantity and value.
shares.emptyBody: This member holds no shares yet. A share purchase is recorded from the shares screen.
shares.withheld: Your role does not cover shares, so this list is not shown.
shares.loadFailed: We could not load this member’s shares.
shares.cancelConsequence: The movement stays in the register with the reason you give, and a purchase's income entry is reversed rather than removed. Nothing is deleted.
shares.reasonHint: A member can ask about this years later, so say what was wrong.

record.title: Record a share movement
record.counterpartyHint: A transfer has two sides, and this is the other one.
record.chooseMember: Search by name or member number
record.categoryHint: Buying shares puts money into the cooperative, so it has to appear in the books.
record.noCategories: No income category has been set up yet, so a purchase cannot be recorded. Add one under Money first.

contributionDialog.title: Record a contribution
contributionDialog.description: For {{name}}, {{code}}. The money is written into the cooperative’s books at the same time.
contributionDialog.noCategories: No income categories have been set up yet, so a contribution cannot be posted to the books. Ask whoever keeps the accounts to add one.

contributionErrors.type: Say what the money is for.
contributionErrors.amount: Write an amount greater than zero, using digits only.
contributionErrors.method: Say how the money was paid.
contributionErrors.categoryId: Choose the income category this money belongs to.
contributionErrors.paidOn: Write the date of payment as a real date.

apiErrors.nationalIdTaken: Another member is already recorded with that national identity number.
apiErrors.contributionAlreadyVoid: That contribution has already been cancelled.

ledger.title: Contributions
ledger.description: Every contribution the cooperative has received, newest first.
ledger.caption: Contributions across the whole cooperative, with the member, the date, the amount and how it was paid.
ledger.cancelConsequence: The contribution stays in the record, and a matching reversal is written into the cooperative's books so the balance returns to what it was. Nothing is deleted.
ledger.cancelled: The contribution for {{name}} was cancelled. The reversal is {{reference}}.
ledger.reasonHint: One line, for example: recorded twice by mistake.
ledger.reasonRequired: Say why this contribution is being cancelled.
ledger.emptyBody: A contribution is recorded from a member's profile, and appears here as soon as it is.
ledger.emptyFilteredBody: Widen the dates or clear the filters to see more.
